target_customer: Data engineers and analytics engineers at companies using dbt and cloud data warehouses
problem: Data teams learn about broken or anomalous data from their users instead of detecting it first.
business_model: Open-source core with a paid managed cloud product (launched 2024 per press) on subscription

founders.name: Maayan Salom
founders.background_notes: Some sources spell the surname Shalom; YC and company use Salom.

founders.name: Or Avidov
education: M.Sc. in computer science and machine learning (YC page)

competitors.name: Monte Carlo
competitors.funding_then: 60M USD Series C in August 2021, 101M USD total

technical_complexity.rationale: dbt-native anomaly detection tests, lineage and a report built on warehouse metadata; moderate for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Open source in a crowded category with funded rivals; community adoption (1,500 teams per Boomi) was the main asset.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not copied out of existence; acquired by Boomi in October 2026 for about 40 to 45 million USD in cash and stock per Calcalist.

market_need_then: Monte Carlo raised 60M USD in August 2021 on rapid growth, showing budget for data observability as dbt and cloud warehouses spread.

branding.domain_note: Uses elementary-data.com; elementary.io belongs to the unrelated elementary OS.

identity.voice_and_tone: Trusted Data for the AI Era

branding.community_and_virality: Open source project and a Slack community referenced on the site; not independently evidenced.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with elementary OS and the word elementary, which hurts search; brand known mostly within the dbt community.

outcome_analysis: Two Unit 8200 alumni built an open-source dbt-native observability tool, raised about 8.5M USD by end of 2022 and added a paid cloud product in 2024. It was acquired by Boomi in October 2026 for roughly 40 to 45 million USD with 17 staff. That is a modest exit relative to funding, delivered by open-source adoption of about 1,500 data teams.
notes: Directory status is Active; the acquisition was announced 2026-10-19, so the exit is recorded with the announcement month. Calcalist states 8.5M USD raised by end of 2022 from TLV Partners, Cowboy Ventures, Y Combinator and angels without naming rounds, so stage is other with no amount; Caplight (aggregator) lists a seed dated 2022-12-17 and 9M total, unverified. Price reports vary (Dealroom about 43M), amount_usd left null. Founded year: 2021 per YC and CB Insights; Boomi coverage says 2022. A Seedtable entry showing a 30M Series B in 2021 appears to describe a different company and is ignored. Competitor search results for Great Expectations, Soda, Metaplane, Bigeye were undated comparison sites and are not recorded. Company site blog about founder education not found for Maayan Salom.
